newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy May low sulphur fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy May low sulphur fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 0.5-percent, low sulphur fuel oil for May delivery, a company official said on Wednesday.
The low sulphur, low pour 38,000 tonne cargo is for delivery May 1-15 to Keelung, Shenao or Taichung and the low sulphur high pour cargo is for delivery May 10-30 to Kaohsiung, the official said.
The tender closes March 26 and is valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought 1.0-percent and 0.5-percent low sulphur fuel oil at $115-$135 per tonne for April/May delivery.
